payload.text: Validate each hand-over from cc, ic and dc against its work package's or issue's acceptance. Under hv's one layer of proof, the verdict is vc's read of the diff, with the builder's measured Desk run as the one run; a second run only when the landed tree differs from the tested one (check with git diff on src, tests and Cargo files). Each verdict goes to the builder's inbox and live, and vc closes a work package with intent wp done once intent at lint is clean for it.
